environment.execution: Local container, headless system Chromium; isolated production build

numerical_oracle.method: Independent exhaustive source-pixel tent weights and direct inverse pinhole equations

source_orientation.method: Every normalized RGBA byte compared with independently transformed native decode baseline

browser_tests.local_evidence: Combined run passed 29/30; the remaining test incorrectly expected pre-normalization low-alpha RGB. Corrected actual-import/canonical-source checks then passed 2/2. All cases individually passed. Remote CI will run the complete suite together.
browser_tests.worker_cleanup: Native jobs checks confirm all created workers terminate on completion, supersession, abort and compressed-image decode failure.
browser_tests.storage: Actual IndexedDB ordering, transaction completion/abort, corrupt and undecodable record preservation, blocked upgrade, unavailable storage, retry and exact demo masks verified.
browser_tests.editor: Real photo import, focal/shift, authored planes, painting, undo/redo, decoded PNG and JSON downloads, reload, invalid import, numeric drafts, keyboard, delayed actual worker messages, delayed native decode, storage unavailable and mobile layout.

maximum_size_measurement.mode: Manual perspective, source 50mm, target 85mm, cyclic row plane labels
maximum_size_measurement.cancellation_note: Abort scheduled after job API returned; reported wall time includes synchronous project validation before worker creation.
maximum_size_measurement.scope: Single local sample, not a cross-device performance guarantee.

manual_visual_check.observations: Source unaltered with depth overlay off; authored subject remains anchored while foreground/background scale, newly uncovered holes remain checkerboard; desktop side-by-side and mobile stacked views inspected. Small independent authored texture also inspected at 40,50,85mm.

limits_and_unverified: No automatic depth inference, generated fill, hidden scene recovery, optical blur, lens distortion or calibrated camera recreation.
Three manually assigned camera-parallel planes approximate relative geometry only.
Browser native color conversion and Canvas normalization define canonical source pixels; low-alpha straight RGB can quantize during that normalization/presentation.
PNG encoder preserves exact kernel bytes; tests do not incorrectly demand Canvas readback preserve all straight low-alpha colors.
Physical camera comparisons, other browser engines and mobile hardware were not verified.
Input/output bounds, local storage and downloadable backups are documented in README.
